name: Exterior Garage Door Protection & Setup
intent: Driveway protection, track/hardware masking, window masking, weatherstrip/bottom seal management, equipment setup.
doctrine: Garage door protection. EA-based per door. Driveway protection uses canvas drops (NOT poly — slip hazard). Track/hardware/weatherstrip masking per door. Bottom seal: remove or mask, prop during cure, reinstall after. Door size modifier (single=1.0, double=1.80) on per-EA tasks.
